summary: Luke Devlin (Amiata Co., former UCLA application reader) spoke with Bhakti about redefining counselor and student success beyond elite-admissions outcomes. He introduced Mark Savickas's Career Construction Inventory 4Cs (Control, Concern, Curiosity, Confidence) and Andrew Hallam's 'four-legged table' framing of success as financial stability, physical/emotional health, purpose, and relationships, alongside Amiata's own structured Fit Factors Card Sort tool for best-fit conversations.
keyInsights: Career Construction Inventory 4Cs: Control, Concern, Curiosity, Confidence.
Andrew Hallam's 'four-legged table' frames success as financial stability + physical/emotional health + purpose + relationships.
Amiata's Fit Factors Card Sort is offered as a structured alternative to ranking-driven best-fit conversations.
